title: Footwork Expert - 2 Weeks
description: The complete JKD mobility system. Integrate Pendulum footwork for elite level entry, exit, and angle creation.

days.notes: Review all intermediate patterns. Ensure total control before adding Pendulum.
Introduction to Pendulum footwork. Master the weight shift and springy recoil.
Pendulum for angle creation. Focus on moving offline immediately after the entry.
Rest day. Pendulum is demanding on your ankles and agility.
Combining elite entry methods. Alternate between bursting and springy entries.
Rhythm and recoil. Use Rock Shuffle to setup Pendulum entries.
Tactical distance management. Use Step and Slide to probe, Pendulum to strike.
Week 1 complete! Week 2 focuses on full integration of all 5 patterns.
Complete arsenal. Focus on smooth transitions from any pattern to any other.
Pendulum endurance and speed. Constant movement with rapid changes in direction.
Complex flow. Practice responding to varying distance scenarios.
Explosive mastery. Your ability to bridge the gap should now be seamless.
High intensity flow. Maintain perfect structure while moving at full speed.
Expert Graduation! You have mastered the complete JKD footwork system.
